notes:
- Account: large payments processor; strict audit & residency rules.
- Primary ask: private (VPC) deployment with SIEM-first audit pipeline and customer-controlled KMS.
- Security team: wants full event stream for all inference transactions (request metadata, model id/version, input hash, token counts) forwarded to their Splunk cluster via an internal forwarder inside VPC.
- Legal: retention constraints, cannot retain PII longer than 90 days; prefer ability to set per-log-type retention.
- Ops: requests syslog/JSON over TLS endpoint + S3-compatible archive for long-term immutable storage.
- Quote from SecOps: "We need field-level mapping for every user-facing request — tieback to merchant id and redaction policy must be demonstrable."
- Priorities: (1) SIEM export + schema, (2) KMS key hierarchy & rotation plan, (3) retention SLAs, (4) admin access logs and RBAC auditability.
use_case_summary: Pilot: compliance monitoring + post-incident forensics for customer support flows. High QPS embedding & chat for automated fraud triage. Hard latency SLOs for support flows (p95 < 220ms) but willing to trade some throughput for stronger audit guarantees.
log_requirements_summary:
Lodestar requires:
- Real-time SIEM export: JSON-over-TLS to a customer-managed forwarder inside VPC (compatible with Splunk HF / Elastic Forwarder).
- Schema contract: canonical fields required (timestamp, request_id, model_id, model_version, route, user_id_or_hash, tenant_id, token_in_count, token_out_count, latency_ms, response_status, redaction_flags, retention_bucket).
- Access logs: admin actions (deploy, rollback, key-change), console/API access, and role changes. Must include actor, timestamp, source IP, and session id.
- Integrity & immutability: option to push logs to WORM S3 bucket with object locking or to an append-only Kafka topic retained for 365 days.
- Retention: operational logs 90 days in SIEM, compliance archives 365+ days in encrypted offsite storage. Need per-bucket retention policies and on-demand export for audits.
- KMS integration: BYOK with hierarchical keys (tenant master key + service-level envelope keys), rotation schedule, and HSM-backed proofs. Redwood must support key usage logs exported to SIEM as separate audit stream.
- Data residency: all logs for EU customers must remain in EU region and cannot be replicated to NA without opt-in.
- Mapping & onboarding: Lodestar requests a CSV/JSON mapping doc and a sandbox SIEM connector for validation prior to production cutover.
implementation_notes:
- Proposed approach: deploy Redwood Private inside Lodestar VPC with a hardened forwarder instance; forwarder will push normalized JSON to Splunk HTTP Event Collector (HEC) endpoint.
- Alternate: syslog TLS export to a managed collector if customer refuses HEC.
- KMS: support AWS KMS BYOK + optional HSM via network HSM appliance; Redwood to provide key rotation playbook.
- Retention enforcement: provide per-log-type TTL at ingestion, plus automated export to cold S3 for >90 day retention.
- Compliance checklist items flagged: SOC2 evidence for log delivery, proof of key separation, residency attestations.
